# Replicating IAM's cell instruments (generated by CANON/replicate.py; do not edit by hand)

**One rule (author): the only code we send anyone to replicate is the full chain.** Side scripts in `development/` and in test
folders are exploration history; they are never the replication path. Every test logged on runs through the chain and is
refused by the push gate otherwise (`CANON/chain_gate.py`).

## How to replicate (chain code only)

1. Clone the repository. The chain is `Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/chain/`; set up its environment from
   [`chain/requirements.txt`](chain/requirements.txt) (Python 3.11). Full cold start: [`chain/RUN_MANIFEST_and_README.md`](chain/RUN_MANIFEST_and_README.md).
2. Check the chain on its constructed tests: `python3 Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/chain/release_check_v3.py`.
3. Read a specimen: `python3 Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/chain/MethylPhys_Interface/run_sample.py` with
   `--grn`, `--red`, `--betas`, `--age`, `--specimen`, `--dev-seq-values`, `--dev-thin`, `--cell-panel`, `--build-construction`, `--build-mix`, `--build-depth`, `--dev-count-only`, `--dev-count-genome`, `--dev-count-sites`, `--dev-metaa-specific`, `--dev-seq-beta`, `--dev-metaa-allsites`, `--dev-territories`, `--dev-ruler`, `--no-territories`, `--dev-plant-territory`, `--dev-plant`, `--banner`, `--out`, `--id`, `--bundle`, `--covariate`, `--covariates`, `--no-bundle`, `--ledger`, `--sex`, `--patient-id`, `--array-type`, `--intake-log`, `--manifest-dir`, `--no-intake`, `--engine`, `--slide-ref-A`, `--slide-ref-table`, `--bam`, `--ref-fasta`, `--assembly`, `--workers`, `--seq-chemistry`, `--dev-iama-position`, `--geo-pat`, `--prior-geo-pat`, `--geo-dir`, `--pat`, `--pat-max-bytes`, `--alignment-qc`, `--iama-ref-table`, `--dev-allow-partial`, `--site-table`, `--seq-pipeline`, `--seq-cell`, `--prior-betas`, `--prior-bundle`, `--save-betas`, `--dev-selftare-ii`, `--build`, `--build-about`, `--build-input`, `--build-groups`, `--build-random`, `--build-out`, `--dev-provisional`, `--build-samples`, `--build-cell`, `--explorer-spec`, `--dev-genome-globe`, `--prior-pat`, `--prior-name`, `--genome-region`, `--dev-info-sphere`, `--no-info-sphere`, `--dev-metaa-atlas`, `--metaa-atlas-ref-A`, `--atlas-v2`, `--sesame-rscript`.
4. Every result the chain writes for a logged test carries a chain stamp (chain version, payload hash, inputs); compare yours with ours.

Chain entry points: `chain/conductor_v3.py`, `chain/stage_v4.py`, `chain/stage_groupa.py`, `chain/stage_metaa_atlas.py`, `chain/stage_q2_globe.py`, `chain/stage_info_sphere.py`, `chain/stage_t_selftare.py`, `chain/stage_seq_values.py`, `chain/stage_1_idat_calibration.py`, `chain/stage_q_iam_a.py`, `chain/stage_q0_intake.py`, `chain/stage_q2_selfref.py`, `chain/stage_atlas_commission.py`, `chain/stage_atlas_u1.py`, `chain/stage_atlas_u1_planted.py`, `chain/stage_atlas_u2.py`, `chain/stage_atlas_u3.py`, `chain/stage_deconv_v21.py`, `chain/stage_temperature.py`.
